extension.summary: Lädt Kodi-Logs zu GitHub oder paste.kodi.tv und Diagnosepakete zu GitHub hoch.
extension.description: Kodi Logfile Uploader mit eigenständiger Debug-Protokollierung, Add-on-Auswahl und Diagnosepaketen mit bereinigten und gefilterten Logs sowie HLS-/DASH-Manifesten.
extension.summary: Upload sanitized and filtered Kodi logs to GitHub or paste.kodi.tv and diagnostic packages to GitHub.
extension.description: Kodi logfile uploader with independent add-on debug logging, installed add-on selection and diagnostic packages containing sanitized originals when small enough, filtered log excerpts and available HLS/DASH manifests.
